parameters._speed_note: Sized against Proxima d (5.1-day period, tightest orbit in any active world mode): ~13 ticks/orbit at this speed, comfortable margin above aliasing risk for the learner's previous->current position training pairs. Press 't' in the running app to snap to true real-time.

organic_budget._budget_note: budget_cpu_ms_per_frame and budget_memory_mb are floors, not ceilings -- when idle_aware_cpu_budget is true, the effective per-frame CPU cap scales up toward budget_cpu_ms_per_frame * idle_cpu_multiplier_cap as the rest of the machine goes idle, and the effective memory cap scales up toward budget_memory_mb * idle_memory_multiplier_cap based on real currently-available system RAM (capped to memory_safety_fraction of it, never more) -- both fall back to their floor when the machine is busy, or on this dev machine (7.7GB total, often ~90% used) when RAM is genuinely tight. See organic_budget.py's _idle_headroom_multiplier()/_idle_memory_multiplier().
